messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 triggered - cross-region routing unrest. Symptoms: requests from ap-southeast1 being routed to us-west2 with a fallback to a trimmed quant model, causing degraded outputs and increased 5xxs. Incident ID INC-2026-04-23. Pager: @Marc (oncall).

Marc (oncall): acknowledged. Quick status please  what routes and customers impacted?

Zoe R.: detecting spike starting ~09:15 UTC. ap-southeast1 frontend error-rate +310%. Fallback-ratio ap->us ~22%. Not all traffic affected, mostly "interactive-chat" routes and some premium clients in APAC.

Hana P.: I pulled recent policy changes: at 09:10 UTC we rolled policy bundle spillover-policy v4 to canary, at 09:12 promoted to global. v4 introduced "region_priority_affinity" which tries to prefer nearest region for latency but will pick lowest-cost compatible model otherwise.

Vikram S.: router log excerpt from ap-router-02:
```
2026-04-23T09:13:05Z INFO policy: evaluate route=/v1/chat user=acct-421 tier=standard decision=spillover to us-west2 reason=region_capacity
2026-04-23T09:13:05Z INFO resolver: requested=rdx-omega-7b available_in_us=rdx-omega-quant selected=rdx-omega-quant
2026-04-23T09:13:06Z ERROR kv_cache: decode failed token=abc123 err=unknown-format
2026-04-23T09:13:06Z WARN proxy: served-model-mismatch expected=rdx-omega-7b served=rdx-omega-quant
```

Priya T.: CS-Bot shows 6 customers filed alerts (2 enterprise APAC, 4 midsize). CS already escalated. Impact: quality regressions (hallucinations) and a few timeouts. Percent of overall traffic ~0.7%.

Marc (oncall): initial hypothesis? Policy v4 changed selection logic and allowed a cross-variant quant fallback that the runtime's KV cache doesn't fully support. If that's true, mitigation options: rollback v4, block spillover from ap-southeast for impacted tiers, or fast patch to resolver to prefer same-weight family. Thoughts?

Zoe R.: I'd prefer minimal blast radius  try block spillover for interactive-chat routes in ap-southeast and hold promotion of v4 while we investigate.

Hana P.: we can push a scoped override: deny-spillover scope=ap-southeast route-pattern=/v1/chat condition=tier>=standard. I can apply immediately.

Vikram S.: applying override now. CLI: 
```
POST /internal/admin/overrides
{ "scope":"ap-southeast1", "pattern":"/v1/chat", "action":"deny_spillover", "note":"INC-2026-04-23 immediate mitig" }
```
response: 200 OK. active at 09:22 UTC.

CS-Bot: Notified affected customers: "We've applied a mitigation to reduce model fallbacks; investigating root cause and ETA to full resolution."

Marc (oncall): collect artifacts for RCA: policy deployment audit, resolver traces, kv cache stack traces, and any model registry changes around 09:00-09:30 UTC. Vikram/Hana handle logs.

Vikram S.: bundling logs to S3: s3://redwood-logs/INC-2026-04-23/bundle-logs.tar.gz. Includes router, resolver, kv cache.

Hana P.: config diffs: v4 changed two keys: "region_priority_affinity": true (new) and "fallback_cost_weight": 0.3 (lowered). That made cost factor override family-safety in some score calculations. I'll attach diff link in RCA.

Zoe R.: I reproduced locally: when cost weight < 0.5, resolver score picks quant variant in remote region even if family mismatch. We saw kv decoding errors because the quant variant uses compressed delta tokens. Failure mode: decoder throws and request returns 502 for some flows.

Priya T.: CS update: enterprise customers asking for ETA. Suggest giving 2-hour window for full RCA and permanent fix.

Marc (oncall): ok. Next steps: keep the override active, roll back global v4 -> v3 if override doesn't bring errors down in 30m. Also prepare a patch to resolver to bump family-safety weight. Hana/Vikram own immediate steps. Zoe do a repro script and add to RCA. Priya handle customer comms.

Vikram S.: monitoring after override: error-rate in ap-southeast dropped to baseline within 8 minutes. fallback-ratio down to 2.4% in that region. Good.

Hana P.: starting patch to revert priority weighting to favor model-family. small change, unit tests local passing. canary plan: 3 routers in ap-southeast at 09:58 UTC.

Zoe R.: repro script (for postmortem):
```
# simulate ap-southeast spillover scenario
curl -H "X-Region: ap-southeast1" -H "X-Tier: standard" -d '{"input":"hello"}' http://router.ap.internal/v1/chat -o /dev/null
# monitor resolver decisions in logs
```

Marc (oncall): decide promotion vs rollback after canary. If canary stable, promote patch and then remove deny-spillover override. Keep CS updated.

Vikram S.: canary running at 09:58. 10 minutes in, no kv errors on canary nodes. fallback selection now prefers same family variants.

Priya T.: CS notified: "We implemented a mitigation and expect full resolution within ~45 minutes pending successful canary."

Marc (oncall): promoting patch to all regions at 10:10 UTC. propagation complete 10:14 UTC. monitoring.

Vikram S.: metrics: global fallback-ratio back to expected baseline, ap-southeast error-rate stable. removing deny-spillover override at 10:20 UTC.

IncidentBot: INC-2026-04-23 marked mitigated at 10:35 UTC. mitigation: patched resolver scoring and removed spillover override. Monitoring in progress.

Marc (oncall): RCA owners and tickets:
- RCA lead: Zoe R. (create INC-2026-04-23-RCA)
- Policy owner: Hana P.
- Resolver/KV owner: Vikram S.
- Customer comms lead: Priya T.

Zoe R.: creating RCA ticket and attaching logs, config diffs, repro scripts. Initial hypothesis for RCA: spillover-policy v4 lowered cost weighting causing resolver to prefer remote quant variants across families, which exposed runtime KV decoding incompatibility.

Hana P.: action items for postmortem:
- adjust policy rollout gating for any change that impacts fallback scoring
- add explicit unit/integration tests to catch cross-family fallbacks
- revert default "fallback_cost_weight" to safe value until testing in place

Vikram S.: runtime actions:
- add defensive checks in KV decoder to error less catastrophically and fall back to safe-path
- extend canary duration for resolver changes from 10m -> 30m for global promotions

Priya T.: CS follow-up scheduled. we'll send affected customers: timeline, mitigation steps, and SLA credit guidance if needed.

Platform-Alerts-Bot: transition incident INC-2026-04-23 to post-incident review queue. Reminder: attach postmortem within 72 hours.

Marc (oncall): handoff - I'm oncall for another 20m then off. @Vikram S. you'll take monitoring. Leave a short note when you pick up.

Vikram S.: taking over monitoring now. current status: patch promoted, metrics normal, customers notified. will update RCA with decoder traces.

Zoe R.: drafting postmortem. ETA for draft: next business day. closing notes: include exact scoring function diff lines and policy canary timeline.

CS-Bot: logged outreach to customers and added notes to their accounts.

Marc (oncall): thanks everyone. good mitigation and quick rollback path.
